actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.calc.CalcServices.refresh#CalcDocument').parameters({roomId: context.roomId}).call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(Object.assign({}, out, {errors}))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.calc.CalcServices.get#CalcState').parameters({roomId: context.roomId}).call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(Object.assign({}, out, {errors}))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.calc.CalcServices.revert#CalcDocument').parameters({roomId: context.roomId}).call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(Object.assign({}, out, {errors}))
ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.calc.CalcServices.close#CalcDocument').parameters({roomId: context.roomId}).call() ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.report.ReportServices.list#Definitions').parameters({definitionType: 'calcgrid'}).call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({errors, userId: ec.user.userId, documents: (out.definitions || []).map((definition) => ({definitionId: definition.id, title: definition.title || definition.id, ownerId: definition.ownerId, userGroupId: definition.userGroupId || null, version: definition.version}))})
